what: A dropped TIFF or LAZ kept through the part upload (large-original-v1) is taken by the existing raster-window or point-batch reader: the raster and point source checks accept that retained receipt within the reader's 16 MiB ceiling, and both Python readers accept its object key.
Enrolment publishes part 0 in usp_intake_parts and queues it in the same transaction, beside the vector queue (intake-surface.ts queueIntakeSurfaceTx; a surface item skips queueIntakeDraftTx).

Each dispatcher tick admits the next planned part of each kept surface, one per file, oldest first, inside the readers' own active and per-source caps (admitIntakeSurfaceParts). A busy reader leaves the part planned.
Job identity: stableUuid(intake-surface/1, item, source revision, part key, context pin); part key = fingerprint(original sha256, reader sha256, locator). The same pin is the same job (D7).

The reader's acceptance transaction publishes the part; the first accepted part plans the rest from what the reader found (dimensions, affine, CRS authority, point count, vertical reference) and writes it to plan_ref.header (D3). The probe card is unchanged.
A stale read returns its part to planned under a fresh pin; any other failure quarantines the part with its code; the item becomes failed_part.

Tray words and state follow the part rows: reading, read or read_to_limit. Placement is on_map only when a part read so far meets the batch area's local extent, in the same PostGIS statement the display read uses (corners transformed into the area's analysis CRS minus its origin, each part's envelope against the area extent); otherwise 'Read, outside this area' (not_understood), waiting_for_anchor without an area, reference or extent, not_understood when the file states no CRS or no transform exists. Vertical reference stays unknown unless the file states it (D4). recordsSeen counts points read; rasters count none.

GET .../intake/items/:itemId/parts (paged) and GET .../parts/:partIndex/display: the reader's accepted fence is checked again (409 if stale), source corners from the window affine or the batch's native XY extent, transformed on the server by postgis:ST_Transform(EPSG:src->area analysis CRS) minus the area origin; a part whose corners do not meet the area's extent is not_placed with reason outside_area; with the accepted artifact path and exact original sha256 (D5). use = display_only.

A kept original refused by its reader's own source check (RASTER_DENIED, RASTER_SOURCE_INTEGRITY, POINT_DENIED, POINT_SOURCE_INTEGRITY) never fails the publishing transaction: the check runs inside a savepoint, the item rests probed / not_understood with words naming the reason and the 16 MiB bound, and nothing is queued. A refusal at a later dispatcher tick quarantines the item's remaining planned parts.
Over a limit the original is kept and the item names the limit in words (D6); point jobsPerSource 32 -> 611 as the proposal's pointOfficerLimits state.
